title: ever CLARYN|Glitter Short Sleeves Round Neck Midi Formal Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your formal style with this chic Asymmetrical Midi Dress! Featuring short sleeves and playful pleated ruffles, this dress is designed to flatter with its round neckline and unique silhouette. The asymmetrical hem adds a touch of modern elegance, while the soft fabric ensures all-day comfort. Perfect for outdoor ceremonies or elegant receptions, this dress transitions effortlessly from day to night. Stand out in any celebration and make unforgettable memories in this stunning piece!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded enough for a "no bra" option, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
